patrick-long@NH.notes_append: Disambiguation 2026-10-07 (MBP-1007-AM): this is Senator Pat Long of Manchester. The NH Senate page (https://gc.nh.gov/senate/members/webpages/district20.aspx, fetched 2026-10-07) reads: "Senator Pat Long (D-Manchester) District 20 ... Years Served in the Senate: Serving his first term, 2025-2026 (current) Years Served in the House: 18 years 2007-2024". He is a different person from Rep. Patrick Long of Hillsborough District 26 (record patrick-long-nh-hillsborough-26). Both records cite HB148; check that roll-call answer against the right chamber before reusing it.

patrick-long-nh-hillsborough-26@NH.notes_append: Disambiguation 2026-10-07 (MBP-1007-AM): this is Rep. Patrick Long of Hillsborough District 26. The NH House page (https://gc.nh.gov/house/members/member.aspx?pid=11177, fetched 2026-10-07) reads: "Representative Patrick Long (D) Hillsborough - District 26 ... PatrickN.Long@gc.nh.gov ... Seat #: 3080". He is a different person from Senator Pat Long of District 20 (record patrick-long). The en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrick_Long_(politician) source on this record is a disambiguation page, not a page about him.

robert-garcia@CA.notes_append: Disambiguation 2026-10-07 (MBP-1007-AM): this is U.S. Rep. Robert Garcia of Long Beach (CA-42). He is a different person from Assemblymember Robert Garcia of California Assembly District 50 (record robert-garcia-ad50).

robert-garcia-ad50@CA.notes_append: Disambiguation 2026-10-07 (MBP-1007-AM): this is Assemblymember Robert Garcia of California Assembly District 50 (https://a50.asmdc.org/, fetched 2026-10-07: "Assemblymember Robert Garcia, California Assembly District 50"). He is a different person from U.S. Rep. Robert Garcia of CA-42 (record robert-garcia). The ballotpedia.org/Robert_Garcia source on this record is the congressman's page, and ballotpedia.org/Robert_Garcia_(Etiwanda_School_District) is a different person again. Neither page is about this assemblymember.
